title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for T1DM.

HPI
Pt is a 61-year-old male presenting for routine follow-up of type 1 diabetes. Pt reports frequent symptoms of hyperglycemia over the last month. States he has been adherent to his insulin regimen but notes elevated thirst and frequent urination. Denies any acute distress.

Medication List
Insulin glargine and insulin lispro.

Exam
Pt is alert and oriented x3. Appearance is well-groomed. Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 74, Temp 98.6 F. General: CTAB. Respiratory: RRR. Cardiovascular: RRR, no murmurs. Skin: Intact, no new lesions.

Assessment
1. Type 1 diabetes: Currently poorly controlled.
2. Hyperglycemia.

Plan
1. Continue current insulin regimen as prescribed. 
2. Monitor blood glucose levels daily. 
3. F/u in 3 months for lab work and A1c.
4. Pt to keep a log of glucose readings and report any significant fluctuations.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: Type 1 diabetes with hyperglycemia / poor control: E10.65.
Do not assign Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes; insulin use is inherent.

distractors.why: Z79.4 is not assigned for type 1 diabetes.
